verdict.rationale: Per-PR preview environments are a fair question for a deployment PaaS like Fly.io, but the evidence pack never documents pull-request-triggered review apps or ephemeral preview deployments. The only related items are developer building blocks: `fly launch`, the Machines REST API, and disposable per-request Sprite VMs. These could be used to build previews but are not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get ephemeral full-stack preview environments for every pull request
